data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE name='mover_transwarp'

tests.name: Transwarp arrival offers toll before movement
Verify payment, fuel and location were committed exactly once

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id,p.credits,c.quantity,(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector'),(SELECT count(*) FROM toll_passage_offers WHERE offer_id='@{transwarp_toll_offer}') FROM players p JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';
